title: Claude Opus 4.8
content:
## Overview

Claude Opus 4.8 was released on May 28, 2026 — roughly seven weeks after Claude Opus 4.7. It is Anthropic's most capable model, with significant improvements in agentic reliability, code quality, and computer use. Pricing is unchanged from Opus 4.7 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.

---

## Dynamic Workflows

The headline addition in Opus 4.8 is **dynamic workflows** — the ability to orchestrate work across tens to hundreds of parallel agents in the background. When given a large-scale task, Claude Code (running Opus 4.8) constructs a workflow that fans out subtasks to specialist agents, monitors their progress, and assembles the results.

A demonstrated use case: a codebase-scale migration from kickoff to merge, spanning hundreds of thousands of lines of code, with the existing test suite as the pass/fail bar. The model handles planning, delegation, debugging, and the final merge autonomously.

---

## Effort Control

Users on claude.ai now have manual control over the **effort level** Claude applies to a task — choosing how deeply Claude reasons before responding. This surfaces as a slider in the UI and as a parameter in the API. Lower effort trades thoroughness for speed; higher effort enables extended thinking for complex problems.

---

## Fast Mode

Opus 4.8 introduces a revised **Fast mode** tier: the model runs at 2.5× standard speed, priced at $10 input / $50 output per million tokens (exactly 2× regular pricing). This is three times cheaper than Fast mode was for prior Opus models, making Opus-tier capability practical for latency-sensitive interactive workloads.

---

## Benchmarks

| Benchmark | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Super-Agent | 100% case completion | Only model to complete all cases end-to-end; matches GPT-5.5 at parity cost |
| Online-Mind2Web (computer use) | 84% | Meaningful jump over both Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5 |
| Code flaw detection | ~4× improvement over Opus 4.7 | Far less likely to let bugs pass without flagging them |

---

## Agentic Improvements

Early testers report sharper judgment on agentic tasks: Opus 4.8 is more reliable about knowing when to pause and check in versus continuing autonomously, more explicit about uncertainty and blockers, and more likely to self-correct during long tool-use chains rather than silently producing an incorrect result.

---

## Availability

Opus 4.8 is available via the Anthropic API (model ID: `claude-opus-4-8`), claude.ai, and AWS. It powers Claude Code's Fast mode when that mode is toggled on.
